visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use rem for sizes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: These font sizes are fixed in pixels, so they ignore a user's chosen text size. Use rem units with the same sizes (the root size is 16px).

solution.explanation: rem is relative to the root font size, so the whole page grows when a user sets a larger text size in the browser. Pixels stay fixed and can make the page hard to read for them.
